artifact.summary: No circuit generated. The specification describes continuous-variable optical phase estimation with a classical robust fixed-interval smoother. It has no gate-based unitary, no finite register, and no fixed construction. Squeezed light, homodyne records, stochastic processes, and minimax smoothing cannot be turned into a faithful finite-qubit Qiskit operation without inventing details the abstract does not give.

equation_mapping.explanation: Assumed Wiener phase-diffusion model is a continuous-time classical stochastic process. It has no finite-qubit unitary form without an arbitrary discretization or encoding.
Fixed-interval smoothing is a classical conditional expectation over a measurement record. It is postprocessing, not a quantum operation.
Minimax MSE criterion is a classical optimization design criterion (and an assumption in the spec). It is not a circuit operation.

specification_changes.change: Abstained from implementation; no scope narrowing to a qubit construction was attempted.
specification_changes.reason: The task needs an operation-only unitary circuit, but the specification is an abstract-level continuous-variable estimation problem. Any qubit circuit would require invented encodings, such as a truncated Fock space or discretized phase register, and an invented noise model.

unresolved_issues: No gate-based operation is specified in the abstract.
The phase noise model, uncertainty set, and robust smoother algorithm are unspecified; the spec assumed them.
Squeezing level and measurement scheme are unspecified.
No public validation contract or requested instance was supplied.
Equations are classical estimation-theory statements and not circuit equations.
